1.w: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah; Issachar and Zebulun;

2.w: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin; Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

3.w: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bathshua, a Canaanite woman. Er, Judah’s firstborn, displeased the Lord , so the Lord killed him.

4.w: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

5.w: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

6.w: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol, Dara —five in all.

7.w: The son of Carmi: Achan, who brought the disaster on Israel when he stole what was devoted to God.

9.w: The sons born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

10.w: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, the tribal chief of Judah.

11.w: Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz.

12.w: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.

13.w: Jesse was the father of Eliab, his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,

16.w: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abshai, Joab, and Asahel.

17.w: Abigail bore Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

18.w: Caleb son of Hezron fathered sons by his wife Azubah (also known as Jerioth). Her sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

19.w: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

20.w: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

21.w: Later Hezron slept with the daughter of Makir, the father of Gilead. (He had married her when he was sixty years old.) She bore him Segub.

22.w: Segub was the father of Jair, who owned twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

23.w: (Geshur and Aram captured the towns of Jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding towns.) All these were descendants of Makir, the father of Gilead.

24.w: After Hezron’s death, Caleb slept with Ephrath, his father Hezron’s widow, and she bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

25.w: The sons of Jerahmeel, Hezron’s firstborn, were Ram, the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

26.w: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah; she was Onam’s mother.

27.w: The sons of Ram, Jerahmeel’s firstborn, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

28.w: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

29.w: Abishur’s wife was Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

30.w: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. (Seled died without having sons.)

31.w: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

32.w: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. (Jether died without having sons.)

33.w: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

34.w: Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. Sheshan had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

35.w: Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha as a wife; she bore him Attai.

36.w: Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad.

37.w: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed.

38.w: Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah.

39.w: Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah.

40.w: Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum.

41.w: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

42.w: The sons of Caleb, Jerahmeel’s brother: his firstborn Mesha, the father of Ziph, and his second son Mareshah, the father of Hebron.

43.w: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

44.w: Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

45.w: Shammai’s son was Maon, who was the father of Beth Zur.

46.w: Caleb’s concubine Ephah bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

47.w: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

48.w: Caleb’s concubine Maacah bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

49.w: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Achsah.

50.w: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrath: Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim,

51.w: Salma, the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the father of Beth Gader.

52.w: The sons of Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim, were Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

53.w: the clans of Kiriath Jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. (The Zorathites and Eshtaolites descended from these groups.)

54.w: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

55.w: and the clans of the scribes who lived in Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who descended from Hammath, the father of Beth Rechab.
